summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Brainsway Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results and operational highlights. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. It is a standard quarterly earnings release with forward-looking guidance. No deal terms are applicable. As a non-US filing, Form 6-K is the equivalent of a US earnings press release. There is no actionable event for risk-arb or special-situations analysis.
